title: Build Production-Grade AI Agents In VS Code
description:
How do you transition an AI prototype from a weekend project into a secure, production-grade application without drowning in skyrocketing API bills? You don’t want to spend $500m a month on Claude bills like that one company…

I have been tinkering with the Microsoft AI Foundry lately. It provides a unified platform to deploy and govern your agents. 

1️⃣ Right inside VS Code, the Microsoft Foundry Toolkit lets you swap out models like Claude, GPT, or Llama with zero changes to your actual application code, eliminating vendor lock-in.

2️⃣ For data grounding, Foundry IQ securely connects your files or databases to your agents. It automatically respects enterprise permissions out of the box, so you don't have to build fragile, custom retrieval pipelines from scratch.

3️⃣ The Model Router analyzes prompts in real-time, dynamically sending simple tasks to cheaper, faster models while reserving expensive models for heavy reasoning. This optimization can cut your inference costs by up to 85%.

👉 You can grab the Microsoft Foundry extension in the VS Code Marketplace: https://fandf.co/4oqHMrb

Sponsored by Microsoft.
